assurance: Executable development controls, not certification or a guarantee against compromise.
limitations: The administrator and owning OS account can alter local files, application code and audit records.
Redaction covers recognized patterns; unknown free text is not certified free of sensitive data.
Structured evidence extraction is deliberately narrow; unsupported formats become coverage gaps.
Browser pairing cannot protect against a compromised browser, extension or OS session.
No live AWS role, IAM policy or Identity Center configuration has been changed or certified.
Current revocations and restrictions are independent of candidate releases; release rollback itself is not implemented.

controls.detail: Exact loopback Host and origins, no forwarded headers, strict JSON and streaming 1 MiB body limit, generic errors, headers, 64 runtime connections.
Five-minute one-use terminal code; digest-only bearer registry; 30-minute idle and eight-hour absolute expiry; logout and restart revocation.
Five pairing attempts and 120 requests per session per minute, 32 sessions and two stream reservations per session.
Text-only component and production CSP. Future report views must use this boundary; no report viewer exists yet.
Typed requests; intersection of pinned policy and current restrictions; audit intent and last-moment recheck; no live handlers enabled.
Pure checks for explicit SSO profile, account, Region and dedicated role; metadata assertions are not proof of MFA.
Distinct raw/sanitized types, bounded allowlisted extraction, scope and content ID validation before storage and export; reusable model/checkpoint/stream gate.
Reject unknown evidence IDs. This checks reference integrity, not semantic support for a claim.
All historical action publication is denied until canonical verification, revocation, calibration and precision gates exist.
Windows current-SID ACL; POSIX 0700/0600; no linked paths or UNC storage; parameterized SQLite; bounded opaque content-addressed artifacts.
Append-only application interface; intent precedes dispatch; audit failure blocks sensitive work; independent persistent restrictions and emergency latch.
Versioned synthetic inputs and expected results, dev-only and ineligible for sealed promotion evidence.
Requires independently verified phishing-resistant MFA configuration, actual SSO/STS role assumption without fallback, IAM and adapter negative contracts. Live startup remains rejected.

Synthetic LangGraph replay, sanitized state, audited node boundaries, content-pinned JSON checkpoints with compare-and-swap, at most two extra evidence rounds, and reauthorization of cached reports. Interrupted fan-out restarts at the preceding serial boundary.

The offline CLI exists; investigation API, model calls and SSE do not. Future live sinks require per-event session checks and dispatch fencing. Offline run pins are development identities, not approved ReleaseBundles or promotion evidence.
Requires transactional budget reservations and adapter-specific dispatch/cancellation fencing before live enablement. A pre-dispatch policy check cannot revoke an already issued external request.
Candidate/scorer/exporter process and IAM isolation are not implemented. No private evaluation or sealed controls are exposed through the API.
Release management must reuse this restriction authority and replay revocations/deletions before restoring data. Recovery targets and signed audit replication require future drills.
